title: Tenant-aware Export Marketplace and Delivery Lanes
creator: Nora Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers and platform teams frequently request bespoke usage exports, cost breakdowns, and scheduled dashboards. Current intake is ad-hoc, leading to inconsistent SLAs, unclear engineering effort estimates, and duplicated connector work. Goal: Create a tenant-aware export marketplace and delivery lanes that standardize intake, set clear SLAs by export archetype (size/frequency/PII sensitivity), and provide self-serve templates for common export tasks.
acceptance_criteria: A documented export archetype matrix mapping request characteristics to delivery lanes (self-serve / concierge / engineering), with recommended SLA bands and estimated engineering effort in points.

A minimal self-serve export catalog in the Console prototype with 4 templates (scheduled CSV export, BigQuery sink, snapshot dashboard, periodic cost-summary report) that can be requested and provisioned by customers without a ticket.
A decision rubric and intake form that surface cost sensitivity, data sensitivity, tenant size, and existing integrations, and which is used by triage to auto-assign priority lanes.
Integration tests and a security review sign-off for template connectors that handle PII or tenant-sensitive cost data.

Pilot delivery for 3 enterprise customers covering different lanes (one self-serve small tenant, one concierge medium tenant, one engineering-heavy large tenant) with post-pilot feedback captured and iteration plan.
Dashboard metrics: time-to-first-delivery by lane, % of requests handled self-serve, and mean engineering hours per request over pilot month.
A final PRD and rollout plan approved by PM, Eng leads, and Design with clear rollback criteria for the pilot phase.
proposed_solution: Define export archetypes (ad-hoc CSV <10MB, scheduled CSV 10MB-1GB, streaming sink to warehouse, dashboard snapshot, high-frequency cost telemetry) and map to delivery lanes: Self-serve (templates + SaaS connectors), Concierge (SE-assisted setup + SLA), and Engineering (custom builds). Build an intake form that computes a priority score and suggested lane. Implement a lightweight Console 'marketplace' UI to browse templates and request setup; behind the scenes this will trigger infra jobs or routing to a concierge queue. Add an SLA matrix in the Console so customers see expected delivery windows and cost estimates before requesting.
milestones: Discovery: stakeholder interviews + sample of 40 tenant requests (2 weeks)
Console prototype for self-serve catalog (2 sprints)
Security review & connector hardening (concurrent with prototype)
Pilot with 3 customers and telemetry collection (4 weeks)
Iterate and prepare rollout plan (2 weeks)
